Title: Characterization of Hom Bifunctor with Left Functor as Composition of Functors

Let $\mathbf {Set}$ be the [[Definition:Category of Sets|category of sets]].

Let $\mathbf C$ be a [[Definition:Locally Small Category|locally small category]].

Let $\mathbf D$ be a [[Definition:Locally Small Category|locally small category]].

Let $L : \mathbf D \to \mathbf C$ be a [[Definition:Covariant Functor|covariant functor]].

Let $\map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf C} } {L-, -} : \mathbf D^{\text{op} } \times \mathbf C \to \mathbf {Set}$ denote the [[Definition:Hom Bifunctor With Left Functor|hom bifunctor with left functor]].

Then:
:$\map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf C} } {L-, -} = \map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf C} } {-, -} \circ \paren{L^\text{op} \times \operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} }$

where:
:* $L^\text{op}$ is the [[Definition:Covariant Functor|covariant functor]] $L^\text{op}: C^\text{op} \to D^\text{op}$ defined by:
:::[[Definition:Object Functor|Object functor]]: for each [[Definition:Object (Category Theory)|object]] $C \in \mathbf C^\text{op} : \map {F^\text{op} } C := \paren{F C}^\text{op}$
:::[[Definition:Morphism Functor|Morphism functor]]: for each [[Definition:Morphism (Category Theory)|morphism]] $f \in \mathbf C^\text{op} : \map {F^\text{op} } f := \paren{F f}^\text{op}$

:* $\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C}$ denotes the [[Definition:Identity Functor|identity functor]] on $\mathbf C$
:* $L^\text{op} \times \operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C}$ denotes the [[Definition:Product of Functors|product of functors]] $L^\text{op}$ and $\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C}$
:* $\map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf C} } {-, -}$ denotes the [[Definition:Hom Bifunctor|hom bifunctor]] $\map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf C} } {-, -} : \mathbf D^{\text{op} } \times \mathbf C \to \mathbf {Set}$
:* $\map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf C} } {-, -} \circ \paren{L^\text{op} \times \operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} }$ is the [[Definition:Composite Functor|composition]] of $\paren{L^\text{op} \times \operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} }$ with $\map {\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf C} } {-, -}$
